_comment: The canonical Predge set. Order = deployer nonce: contract i is created at nonce i, so with the same fresh deployer and the same args every chain gets the same addresses. Never reorder or insert; append only, and only after every chain has the current list.

plan.name: AgentJob
plan.role: ERC-8183 job escrow with Predge as named evaluator

plan.name: PredgeValidatorBond
plan.role: validator bond, slashable by anyone in the window after the verdict

plan.name: PredgeSettlement
plan.role: pay-per-route receipts in the native token

plan.name: MockRefundProtocol
plan.role: stand-in Refund Protocol the arbiter drives (no Circle Refund Protocol on these chains)

plan.name: PredgeRefundArbiter
plan.role: bonded refund arbiter; rule() needs evidence filed on-chain first
